name: Turnover-Concentration Herfindahl (participation-structure conditioning)
conditioning_space: positioning/liquidity information (mission Q2): depth/turnover structure — temporal concentration of participation

item1_mechanism.one_paragraph: The temporal SHAPE of a symbol's participation — whether its dollar turnover is spread evenly across days or packed into a few episodic bursts — is a structural property of who is trading. TCH measures it as the Herfindahl index of daily dollar-turnover shares over the trailing 28 days: H_s = sum_i (t_i / sum_j t_j)^2, t_i = day-i dollar turnover from completed 15m bars (H = 1/28 when turnover is perfectly even, H = 1 when it all lands on one day; scale-invariant to the LEVEL of turnover by construction). Economic counterparty: in high-H (burst-churned) symbols the marginal price is set during episodic thin-book episodes dominated by impatient directional takers, against liquidity providers who must re-quote after each burst; in low-H (steady-participation) symbols continuous two-sided flow keeps books populated and price discovery orderly (Admati & Pfleiderer 1988). Why the edge exists: episodic burst flow arrives disproportionately after information has already diffused (attention-driven participation), so burst-churned symbols' marginal prices embed late, impatient taker prints taken from temporarily thin books, and are progressively re-priced relative to orderly books over the following week. Expected sign: LOW-concentration symbols outperform HIGH-concentration symbols over the following week; long the lowest-H tercile, short the highest-H tercile.
signal_inputs: daily dollar turnover shares (28d/56d window) — shape only
signal_exclusions: no turnover level or growth term (scale-invariant H)

item2_falsifiable_prediction.passes_when: anchor after-cost expectancy > 0 AND position PF >= 1.10 AND >= 2/3 chronological folds positive; excess over BTC buy-and-hold AND over BTC-beta context positive in >= 2/3 folds; causal control fails at least one of the anchor's three gates
falsified_if_any_of: anchor fails any of the three gates (participation-structure premium absent or sign-wrong after costs)
anchor passes but CTL-VOLLEVEL also passes all three (edge is a volatility-level effect, matching the documented vol-level sorting shadow observation; the participation-SHAPE claim is redundant)
BTC-beta-context excess non-positive in >= 2 folds (beta repackaging)
56d neighbour contradicts anchor sign or is unstable across folds (window-fragile statistic)
post-hoc diagnostics show the anchor book mechanically equivalent to a past-return sort (forbidden reversal variant in disguise; construct is not what it claims)
A7-N |rho| > 0.20 vs frozen OILEV-V2 anchor OR its inverted control (voluntary novelty commitment)
item2_falsifiable_prediction.no_rescue_rule: no parameter retune, sign flip, cap change, universe carve-out or threshold relaxation may rescue any failure mode

primary_claims_used: participation clustering is endogenous and price-relevant (L1)
thin-book episodes amplify transient impact; liquidity providers withdraw/widen under episodic pressure (L4, L2-mechanism)
turnover LEVEL is a priced liquidity proxy in equities — a confound TCH's scale-invariance explicitly addresses (L3)
transfer_caveats: equity participation-shape evidence is intraday and session-structured; TCH re-expresses it as a weekly Herfindahl over UTC days on a 24/7 market with no open/close clock — the analog level of the construct is an assumption, not a measurement

crypto bursts are frequently liquidation-driven; a high-H reading may reflect past forced-flow rather than standing participant mix — TCH claims only a structure/attention association, not a cascade prediction

Nagel's liquidity-provision proxy is a REVERSAL strategy; reversal families are forbidden here, so TCH must stand purely on its shape signal — if its edge cannot be separated from a return-sort equivalent, the family is falsified
Herfindahl over 28 daily aggregates has a small-sample floor (1/28); cross-symbol comparison valid only among symbols with complete 28-day coverage (fail-closed eligibility)
one 52-week window may be regime-specific; fold and drop-one gates are the preregistered guard

derived.H_s(T): sum_{i=1..28} (t_i / sum_j t_j)^2 — Herfindahl of daily dollar turnover shares over the trailing 28 UTC days; every day fully covered by completed 15m bars (completed-bar integrity, no gap-filling); fewer than 28 complete daily aggregates -> symbol INELIGIBLE, fail-closed
derived.scale_invariance: H_s is invariant to the LEVEL of turnover (a scalar multiplication of all t_i leaves H_s unchanged): exposure to the priced turnover-level channel is structurally minimized by construction

item5_universe_warmup_clock_schedule.book_construction: rank eligible symbols by H ascending; long lowest-H tercile (6, steady participation), short highest-H tercile (6, burst participation), middle 7 buffer; enter on tercile entry, exit only when rank crosses beyond the median (hysteresis buffer); equal weights w = min(0.5/n_side, 0.30); n_side < 2 -> side budget to cash; side membership < 4 -> skip that stamp's rebalance, hold previous book (fail-closed); gross <= 1.0; intended holding spans >= 7d by construction

anchor.signal: H_s over 28d daily turnover shares; long lowest-H tercile, short highest-H tercile

neighbour.signal: identical construction with a 56d window (Herfindahl over 56 daily shares)
neighbour.justification: same mechanism, different justified parameter: a single burst day moves a 28d Herfindahl by ~3.6 percentage points of mass but a 56d one by ~1.8, halving single-episode sensitivity; 56d warmup inside authorized window

causal_negative_control.signal: rank ASCENDING on trailing 28d realized volatility of daily log returns (daily closes from completed 15m bars); long lowest-vol tercile, short highest-vol tercile
causal_negative_control.justification: the mechanical vol-level shadow of the anchor's exposure: bursty turnover co-occurs with volatile days, so low-H mechanically correlates with low realized vol; the control retains that exposure and deletes the turnover-SHAPE information

item6_arms.preregistered_control_rule: IF anchor TCH-28D passes {after-cost expectancy > 0, position PF >= 1.10, >= 2/3 folds positive}, THEN CTL-VOLLEVEL must fail at least one of those three gates; if CTL-VOLLEVEL also passes all three, the edge is a volatility-level effect — the pattern of the documented vol-level sorting shadow observation — and A13-V13-A8-TCH is FALSIFIED as a participation-structure mechanism
item6_arms.control_discipline: control uses no funding signal and no return term in its own ranking (realized vol of daily closes is a risk level, not a momentum/reversal sort); identical clock, costs, folds and gates as the anchor

item7_incremental_test.excess_buy_and_hold: per fold f: arm_net_f - BTC_buy_and_hold_f (BTCUSDT perp, same fold window, identical force-flat convention)
item7_incremental_test.excess_btc_beta_context: per fold f: arm_net_f - beta_p * BTC_f; beta_p = trailing 90d daily regression beta of the arm's mark-to-market daily returns vs BTCUSDT daily returns (daily closes from completed 15m bars), estimated PIT at the fold's first decision stamp, held fixed over the fold
item7_incremental_test.gate: Stage-A unrelaxed: both excess series positive in >= 2/3 folds; failure of either in >= 2 folds falsifies the family's Q2 claim

item12_shadow_region_determination.reasoning: the mechanism is stated in its own words (endogenous participation clustering and thin-book price setting), never as 'the inverted anchor'; its conditioning construct — the temporal concentration of dollar turnover — is read by no forbidden family, and none of the three measured shadow observations (inverted OI-flow +0.758; V11 LOT inversion; stocks-program vol-level sorting) involves a turnover-shape ranking; TCH is not an inversion, rescue or renaming of any listed family (item 11); no front-door disclosure of a previously observed identical sign is claimed because no such observation exists for this construct; the vol-level control exists precisely because a CONFOUND (not the mechanism) resembles one of the shadow observations
